name: City social credit
description: A municipal platform that assigns residents a social score from their payment history and online behaviour, and restricts access to services for low scorers.

name: Workplace mood monitor
description: Webcam software that reads the emotions of employees during video calls and reports engagement to managers.

name: Face database builder
description: A crawler that scrapes facial images from social media to build a searchable face database.

name: Predictive policing
description: A model that predicts whether a person will commit a crime based on their personality traits and neighbourhood.

name: CV screener
description: Ranks job applications and filters CVs before a recruiter sees them.

name: Loan approval model
description: Scores creditworthiness of applicants and recommends loan approval or rejection.

name: Exam proctoring
description: Monitors students through their webcam during online exams and flags possible cheating.

name: Grid balancing
description: Controls load balancing on the national power grid as a safety component.

name: Visa triage
description: Prioritises visa applications for manual review by immigration officers.

name: Card fraud detection
description: Detects card payment fraud in real time for a bank and blocks suspicious transactions.

name: Support chatbot
description: A chatbot on a retail website that answers customer questions about orders and returns.

name: Marketing image generator
description: Generates product images for marketing campaigns from short text prompts.

name: Spam filter
description: Filters spam email in a company inbox using a naive Bayes model.

name: Game opponent
description: An AI opponent for a card game that picks moves with Monte Carlo tree search.
